description: Implement SmartMarketSelector to replace MensionePickGenerator with sophisticated market evaluation. Evaluates all markets from MarketProbabilities, ranks by selection_score (probability × confidence × (1 + edge)), applies filters (min_confidence=0.4, min_probability=0.5, min_edge=0.0), returns BestTip or PassDecision. Includes value classification (STRONG_VALUE ≥10%, VALUE ≥5%, NEUTRAL ≥0%, NEGATIVE_VALUE <0%) and risk levels (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH based on confidence/agreement/quality thresholds).
steps: Read backend/app/prediction/mensione_pick.py to understand current MensionePickGenerator structure
Read backend/app/prediction/market_derivation.py MarketProbabilities dataclass to understand available markets

Create backend/app/prediction/market_selector.py with imports: from dataclasses import dataclass, field; from typing import Optional, Dict, List, Union; from datetime import datetime; from app.prediction.market_derivation import MarketProbabilities; from app.prediction.confidence_engine import ConfidenceAssessment

Define BestTip dataclass with fields: match_id (str), market (str), selection (str), probability (float), confidence (float), model_agreement (float), data_quality (float), edge (Optional[float]), fair_odds (float), bookmaker_odds (Optional[float]), odds_movement (Optional[float]), value_classification (str), risk_level (str), selection_score (float), selector_reason (str), timestamp (datetime), pipeline_version (str)

Define PassDecision dataclass with fields: match_id (str), pass_reason (str), evaluated_markets_count (int), best_market_details (Optional[Dict[str, any]]), timestamp (datetime), pipeline_version (str)
Implement SmartMarketSelector class: __init__(min_confidence=0.4, min_probability=0.5, min_edge=0.0, max_risk_level='HIGH', pipeline_version='1.0.0')

Implement evaluate_and_select(match_id: str, market_probs: MarketProbabilities, confidence_assessment: ConfidenceAssessment, odds_data: Optional[Dict[str, float]] = None) -> Union[BestTip, PassDecision]
In evaluate_and_select: extract all markets from market_probs (home_win, draw, away_win, over_2_5, under_2_5, btts_yes, btts_no, double_chance markets, top exact scores)

For each market: calculate fair_odds = 1.0 / probability; if odds_data provided, get bookmaker_odds and edge = (probability * bookmaker_odds) - 1.0; classify value: STRONG_VALUE (edge≥0.10), VALUE (edge≥0.05), NEUTRAL (edge≥0.0), NEGATIVE_VALUE (edge<0.0)
Calculate risk_level: LOW (confidence≥0.7 AND model_agreement≥0.8 AND data_quality≥0.7), MEDIUM (confidence≥0.5 AND model_agreement≥0.6 AND data_quality≥0.5), HIGH (below MEDIUM)
Calculate selection_score = probability * confidence * (1.0 + edge) if edge else probability * confidence
Filter markets: probability ≥ min_probability, confidence ≥ min_confidence, edge ≥ min_edge (if odds_data), risk_level ≤ max_risk_level
Rank by selection_score descending; select top market as BestTip with all fields populated
If no markets qualify, return PassDecision with pass_reason explaining which filter failed, evaluated_markets_count, best_market_details (highest scored market even if disqualified)
Create backend/tests/test_market_selector.py with fixtures for MarketProbabilities and ConfidenceAssessment

Test cases: (1) select best when multiple qualify, (2) PASS when confidence below threshold, (3) PASS when probability below threshold, (4) PASS when edge below threshold, (5) PASS when risk too high, (6) value classification STRONG_VALUE for 12% edge, (7) value classification VALUE for 7% edge, (8) value classification NEUTRAL for 2% edge, (9) value classification NEGATIVE_VALUE for -3% edge, (10) risk level LOW for high scores, (11) risk level MEDIUM for moderate scores, (12) risk level HIGH for low scores, (13) no odds_data case (edge=None, still selects), (14) tie-breaking by probability, (15) PassDecision includes best_market_details
Run tests: cd backend && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/test_market_selector.py -v
acceptance_criteria: evaluate_and_select() evaluates all markets from MarketProbabilities
Filters applied: min_confidence, min_probability, min_edge, max_risk_level
Value classification: STRONG_VALUE (≥10%), VALUE (≥5%), NEUTRAL (≥0%), NEGATIVE_VALUE (<0%)
Risk levels: LOW (conf≥0.7, agree≥0.8, qual≥0.7), MEDIUM (conf≥0.5, agree≥0.6, qual≥0.5), HIGH (below)
PassDecision issued when no markets qualify with descriptive pass_reason
15+ unit tests covering all scenarios, all passing
verification: Verify output shows 15+ passed tests for SmartMarketSelector
